purpose: Implemented bounded pipe-session process graph and scoped file-editing artifacts for optional AI CLI adapters in the desktop shell.

artifacts.retention_policy: Session output is runtime UI state unless explicitly promoted into a task record.
artifacts.cleanup_policy: Truncate in memory and clear when sessions are discarded.
validation: Decision prompts are detected before source-affecting release.

artifacts.retention_policy: Backup files are retained for manual rollback after scoped source edits.
artifacts.cleanup_policy: Backups can be pruned by a future retention policy after review.
provenance: original workspace text file before write

artifacts.retention_policy: Open decisions remain until the human answer/resume workflow updates their status.
artifacts.cleanup_policy: Duplicate ids for the same session prompt are skipped; answered decisions are handled by workflow 61.
validation: Decisions and decision_history arrays are preserved.
No source-affecting continuation is authorized by the append.

resource_controls.timeout_policy: Sessions use SESSION_TIMEOUT_MS and cancel/timed-out paths kill and wait for child processes.
resource_controls.cancellation_policy: cancel_cli_adapter_session kills and waits for the child process.
resource_controls.cleanup_policy: stdin is dropped when sessions finish; reader threads are joined when finished during polling; duplicate decision inbox records for the same session prompt are skipped.
resource_controls.orphan_process_policy: This MVP tracks direct child processes only; PTY/process-group cleanup remains follow-up.
resource_controls.backpressure_policy: stdout/stderr readers append into bounded buffers and set truncation flags.

merge_strategy: The Desktop tab does not release autonomous source-affecting changes from CLI output. Detected questions can be deferred into the human decision inbox; source writes require explicit user interaction in the scoped editor and create backups.
plan_evidence: The user asked to continue implementing missing desktop app functionality.
The previous MVP already created adapter detection and health checks.
Pipe sessions and scoped editing are the smallest implementation before PTY/xterm/Monaco dependency audit.

rollback_plan: Remove session/editor commands from Tauri invoke_handler if the desktop bridge regresses.
Disable the Desktop session console and source editor UI while keeping health checks.
Use generated source-editor backups to manually roll back edited files.
notes: This pipeline record models the implemented direct child process/session layer. It is not a full PTY process-group supervisor.
